source_boundary.book: 2016 Crown paperback9780804136716;2015eBook separate. Authorized Chapter1 excerpt and separately published book-derived guidance inspected;later book chapters uninspected.
source_boundary.mellers: 2014Psychological Science25(5),1106–1115;daily/question tournament averaging andquestion standardization are not our fixed-cutoff score. Two-category loss is twice binary Brier.

rights: Source facts andoriginal implementation/fixtures only;no book/article bodies orsourcePDFs redistributed. Later book chapters uninspected;no GJP dataset acquired orfile-level license/participant privacy completeness certified. User snapshot rights remain declarations.

numeric.input: Plain decimal or integer/fraction strings only,up to60digits per integer;no exponent,float,bool or nonfinite values. Denominator positive.
numeric.log: Decimal80 natural log of exact fraction;aggregate unrounded Decimal80 losses then round display to12places. Positive infinity structured;no clipping ornonfinite JSON.

display_implementation: Rational outputs use exact integer HALF_EVEN projection to12decimal places,including very large finite relative ratios;logarithms andunrounded log aggregation useDecimal80.

chronology.timestamps: Timezone-aware UTC Z timestamps with seconds;question timezone UTC only. All times are declared,not externally attested.
chronology.window: [window_start,window_end);positive occurrence withinwindow;negative occurrence_at must be null,outcome_known_at>=window_end.
chronology.freeze: Source availability<=class availability cutoff<=class freeze<=plan creation;question source<=question lock<=plan creation<=question cutoff<=window_end;created<=locked. Partition frozen<=plan creation. Baseline frozen<=plan creation.
chronology.selection: One latest accepted forecast by append sequence per slot,recorded_at<=cutoff,knowledge_at<=cutoff,strictly before earliest declared outcome-known time andpositive occurrence across ALL resolution history;outcome_known must be false. Late/postknown versions retained butunscored.
chronology.resolution: Positive occurrence<=outcome_known_at<=source.available_at<=recorded_at;publication_at<=source.available_at. Negative window_end<=known<=available<=recorded;no invented occurrence. Nonresolved outcome null. Resolved-to-resolved correction requires intervening dispute/void.
chronology.actions: Nondecreasing declared action time;accepted record recorded_at equals action at. Rejected attempts retain original payload anddeterministic reason,consume chain sequence butnever state. Source records with sameID must remain byte-identical amongaccepted records.

reference_class_policy: One member record per distinct event ID,including exclusions/ambiguous/unresolved. Exact rate uses included resolved only;denominators/statuses andallIDs preserved. No automaticprior. Classes bind targetquestion anddigest. No historical member event ID overlaps any planned event;historical groups mustbe training groups anddisjoint test groups. Representativeness remains a declaration.
forecast_policy: Planned unique slot(question,participant);question version1/hash andparent/version checked. Original/manual revisions distinct fromBayes. Optional documentary reasoning never generates probability.
evidence_policy: New IDs andoriginal_fact_id andsnapshot hashes per slot across ALL earlier accepted evidence. One new evidence perBayes update. First uses dependence=first;subsequent independent requires distinct groups andexplicit independence under H AND notH plusprovenance. Conditional requires conditioned_on exactly allprior evidenceIDs in insertion order;repeated facts neveraccepted. User-assumed/declared-measured labels aredeclarations,not empirical model certification.

scoring_policy.primary: Equal forecast-slot weight overselected resolved TEST questions;not daily/tournament score. Training/test summaries separate;all planned slots/questions visible.
scoring_policy.brier: Exact binary0–1 andseparately namedtwo-category0–2;no implicit mixing.
scoring_policy.log_endpoints: finite/correct certain zero/positive_infinity/not_estimable statuses;no NaN/Infinity literal.
scoring_policy.decomposition: Group exact identical Fractions;report REL/RES/UNC andverifyidentity independently from coarse calibrationbins.
scoring_policy.baseline: Per-question precommitted constant or exact linked-class rate onidentical selected pairs;unpaired exclusions explicit. Relative skill onlywhenbaseline loss>0.
scoring_policy.denominators: Separate slots,versions,rejected attempts,questions,events,participants anddependencygroups. Event-average andparticipant-average losses separately named;no automaticteam aggregate.
scoring_policy.heldout: Frozen group partitions;historical reference observations/source availability beforeplan/test. Sentinel changes future resolutions cannotchange plan/priors/forecastversions/evidence/partitions.

provenance: Inline bounded source snapshots SHA256 of exact UTF8 text;explicit rights(self_authored,public_domain,permission_granted,cc_by),attribution,locator,availability. No generic copyrighted source corpus ingestion. Local owner can rewrite hashes/history;independent anchoring remains P1.

variant_matrix.bayesian_updates: Exact supplied finite likelihood ratios/conditional pairs;dependence provenance guards,not empirical model validation
variant_matrix.brier_log_scoring: Explicit fixed-cutoff slot-average losses andsafe endpoints;historical daily/question tournament protocol unimplemented
